summary: Iteration 7 — backend-only validation of the dynamic voice-backend selection fix in /app/server.py (_pick_voice_backend / _voice_setup_hint / X-Voice-Backend header). Created /app/tests/test_voice_backend_selection.py (9 tests, destructive .env scenarios with server restarts + auto-restore) — 9/9 PASS. Re-ran existing /app/tests/backend_test.py — 16/16 PASS. Total 25/25. Verified: (1) current pod (both libs + EMERGENT_LLM_KEY) → POST /api/voice/tts 200, Content-Type audio/mpeg, X-Voice-Backend: emergent, body 65k+ bytes; (2) EMERGENT_LLM_KEY= and OPENAI_API_KEY= empty → TTS and STT both return 503 JSON with error mentioning BOTH 'OPENAI_API_KEY' and 'EMERGENT_LLM_KEY' ('Configure OPENAI_API_KEY no /app/.env (crie em https://platform.openai.com/api-keys) OU EMERGENT_LLM_KEY (se rodando dentro do Emergent).') — the old isolated 'EMERGENT_LLM_KEY não configurada' message no longer appears; (3) in-process with _HAS_EMERGENT=_HAS_OPENAI=False and no keys → _pick_voice_backend() returns (None,'') and hint contains 'pip install openai' + 'pip install emergentintegrations' install instructions; also verified emergent-lib-only-without-key falls through to None and OPENAI_API_KEY-only picks ('openai','sk-fake'); (4) EMERGENT_LLM_KEY empty + OPENAI_API_KEY=sk-openai-fake-test-key → TTS and STT return HTTP 500 (NOT 503) with error 'Falha na síntese (openai): ... Incorrect API key provided' i.e. the openai backend was actually attempted; (5) regression: /api/tools 200 with tools manifest, /api/system/info|cpu|disk 200, /api/auth/login sets signalis_session cookie, unauth /api/voice/* → 401, empty text → 400, invalid voice/model → 400, garbage audio → readable 500 (no traceback/HTML). /app/.env was backed up to /tmp/env.bak and is fully RESTORED (EMERGENT_LLM_KEY=sk-emergent-534De521b39A46a36E) with the server restarted and TTS working again. Frontend not tested (backend-only request; iteration 6 covered frontend).
critical_code_review_comments: _voice_setup_hint() has a dead branch: the final 'elif _HAS_EMERGENT and _HAS_OPENAI and not em_key and not oa_key' can never run because the first 'if not em_key and not oa_key' already catches it. Harmless, but dead code.

Only STT returns the chosen backend in the JSON body ('backend'); TTS exposes it via the X-Voice-Backend header. Consider also adding X-Voice-Backend (or the field) to STT responses for symmetry/debuggability.

500 error paths embed the raw provider message truncated to 200 chars (str(e)[:200]); with a real OPENAI_API_KEY this could leak part of a key or provider internals into the browser. Consider sanitizing.
/app/server.py is 1225 lines — consider splitting (voice, system, spotify, fs handlers) into modules per the >700-line guideline.
_pick_voice_backend() reads env on every request (good), but load_dotenv() runs only at import, so editing /app/.env still requires a restart — worth documenting in README/requirements.txt.
seed_data_creation: None. /app/.env temporarily modified for 3 scenarios and restored from in-memory original + /tmp/env.bak.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Server is NOT supervisor-managed: run `cd /app && nohup python3 server.py > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 &` (port 8000, BASE_URL=http://localhost:8000). /app/tests/test_voice_backend_selection.py rewrites /app/.env and restarts the server; its module-scoped env_restore fixture always restores the original file — run it with `-p no:randomly` and NOT in parallel (xdist) since it mutates global state. Real audio/mic flows and frontend were not exercised in this iteration (iteration 6 covered frontend 12/12).
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug: voice backend was resolved once at import time (global VOICE_BACKEND), so a user with emergentintegrations installed but no EMERGENT_LLM_KEY always got a 503 'EMERGENT_LLM_KEY não configurada' even with OPENAI_API_KEY set. The fix (per-request _pick_voice_backend() + specific _voice_setup_hint()) is verified working: key selection is now dynamic per request and the 503 message names both keys plus install instructions.
